relevance.rationale: WRONG JOIN - report loudly. The seeded id was faddeev_kashaev1994. This document is arXiv:2305.14884v2 [math.GT], 'Perturbative invariants of cusped hyperbolic 3-manifolds', by Garoufalidis, Storzer and Wheeler, revised 12 Jul 2023. Third of four uploads in this slice wrongly seeded to faddeev_kashaev1994 - the phrase 'Faddeev quantum dilogarithm' appears in its Sec. 2.1, which is presumably what the matcher latched onto. No registered key matches: grep for '2305.14884' and 'Storzer' returns nothing; the Wheeler hits in references.ts are fantini-wheeler2024 (a different paper, though a same-author neighbour) and unrelated Breit-Wheeler entries. Set id to null. Verdict undetermined: identification settled, relevance not genuinely assessed. Clearly on-topic - it proves that a formal power series attached to an ideally triangulated cusped hyperbolic 3-manifold is a topological invariant, conjecturally agreeing to all orders with the Kashaev invariant and the Andersen-Kashaev state integral - and the corpus already carries a Fantini-Wheeler Borel-summability audit, so this needs a real first pass.
